subject: Brightline: request for deploy-gate proofchain and change chronology
messages:
From: Emma Patel <emma@brightline.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Brightline intake — deploy-gate proofchain + change chronology request

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking this through. Brightline is continuing the SIG intake for FinServCo and we need artifacts that demonstrate the deploy-gate "proofchain" and change chronology for production releases for a 6-month sample. Specifically we are asking for:

- a small sample (3–5) of PRs including author, reviewers, timestamps and merge action (redacted where necessary)
- CI run logs for the failed->fixed->re-ran flows (we're mainly after timestamps and runner IDs)
- evidence of ephemeral credential usage and rotation (shortlived token issuance logs / consumer)
- a terse chronological change log that ties PR id -> CI job -> deploy ticket -> deploy completion with timestamps

Can you let me know what you can provide in the next 5 business days and if you need a specific format or redaction guidance? Also confirm whether attachments may be shared via a restricted Drive link.

Best,
Emma
Emma Patel
Assurance Lead, Brightline Security
emma@brightline.com

[External assessor intake form: REF-7782]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Patel <emma@brightline.com>
Cc: Sam Wong <sam.wong@finserv.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brightline intake — deploy-gate proofchain + change chronology request

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear checklist. We can deliver a compact evidence bundle that maps to each bullet. Planned deliverables (target: 5 business days):

1) PR sampling: anonymized CSV mapping pr_id, author_id, reviewer_ids, created_at, merged_at (redaction: full emails replaced with internal IDs)
2) CI run excerpts: job start/finish timestamps, runner_id, job_status, short log snippets (no secrets)
3) Token rotation: ephemeral-token issuance audit (token id -> consumer service -> ttl -> rotate event)
4) Change chronology: a chronological log mapping pr_id -> ci_job_id -> deploy_ticket -> deploy_complete_ts

We will provide these as: CSV/CSV/CSV/text + a single PDF runbook excerpt for our CI gating policy. We'll upload to a restricted Drive folder and share a view-only link.

Quick question: do you need the original git SHAs or is per-PR id sufficient (we prefer to omit raw SHAs in assessor artifacts)? Also confirm whether Brightline prefers logs redacted by us or if you want the raw logs under NDA.

I'll coordinate the internal collection and reply here with links.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Product Security Manager | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Office: +1 415 555 0198

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Brightline intake — deploy-gate proofchain + change chronology request

Team — forwarding Brightline's ask (see below). Action items and owners:

- Irene: please produce the anonymized PR sample (3–5 entries). Use the internal id mapping spreadsheet and remove SHA values. Put file: commit-ownership-matrix.csv in the Drive folder.
- Jordan: pull CI job excerpts for the sample PRs (failed->fix->rerun flows where applicable). Include runner IDs and job timestamps, trim logs to the first 1200 chars per job. File: ci-runbook-snippet.pdf (pdf with embedded log excerpts).
- Marissa: export the ephemeral token issuance audit for the services involved (token issue events, rotate events). Create deploy-change-chronology.log mapping pr_id -> ci_job_id -> deploy_ticket -> deploy_complete_ts.

Deadline: EOD Monday (2028-06-17) to allow time for redaction and packaging before we hand to Brightline next Tuesday. If any item is blocked, flag here with the blocker.

Notes on redaction: we will remove user emails and raw commit SHAs, but keep internal ids and timestamps intact. Drive path: /Compliance/Brightline/FinServCo/2028-06-proofchain (I will create and share link).

Thanks — Mateo

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Brightline intake — deploy-gate proofchain + change chronology request

Mateo — uploading the artifacts now. Quick status:

- PR sample (anonymized) created by Irene: commit-ownership-matrix.csv attached to Drive folder. Sample rows include pr-2028-043, pr-2028-117, pr-2028-202.
- CI excerpts captured from our CI archival for the requested window. Per your instruction I trimmed logs and removed any environment variables. CI excerpts include job ids: ci-9981, ci-10014, ci-10043.
- Ephemeral token audit: exported from our auth-audit service; contains token_issue_id, consumer_service_id, issued_at, rotated_at. Note: tokens older than 90 days were not requested so none included.
- Change chronology assembled into deploy-change-chronology.log. Small excerpt below: 

--- deploy-change-chronology.log (excerpt) ---
pr-2028-043 -> ci-9981 -> deploy-567 -> deploy_complete: 2028-03-21T03:12:04Z
pr-2028-117 -> ci-10014 -> deploy-602 -> deploy_complete: 2028-04-09T18:27:22Z
pr-2028-202 -> ci-10043 -> deploy-633 -> deploy_complete: 2028-05-30T11:59:08Z
--- end excerpt ---

Attachments placed in restricted Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEFgHIjk2_sample (view-only; Brightline access pending). Files added: commit-ownership-matrix.csv, ci-runbook-snippet.pdf, deploy-change-chronology.log, pr-review-sample.patch (sample review diff).

If you want raw SHAs for cross-correlation under NDA, let me know and I can produce a redacted-to-ndareadme file.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Patel <emma@brightline.com>, Sam Wong <sam.wong@finserv.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Jun 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Delivering Brightline evidence bundle — deploy-gate proofchain (FinServCo sample)

Hi Emma / Sam — thanks for your patience. Per your checklist we have uploaded a compact bundle for a 3-PR sample covering PR metadata, CI run excerpts, ephemeral token audit, and a deploy change chronology. Delivery summary below: 

Delivered artifacts (restricted Drive link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEFgHIjk2_sample
Files included: 
- commit-ownership-matrix.csv  (anonymized mapping: pr_id, author_id, reviewer_ids, created_at, merged_at)
- ci-runbook-snippet.pdf     (selected CI job excerpts; runner_ids + timestamps; logs trimmed)
- deploy-change-chronology.log (pr_id -> ci_job_id -> deploy_ticket -> deploy_complete_ts)
- pr-review-sample.patch     (small sample diff and review baton for context)

Redaction and format notes:
- We removed raw git SHAs and replaced user emails with internal IDs.
- No secrets or environment values are included.
- Logs were truncated to the first 1200 characters per job to keep the bundle concise.

Related records: HubSpot ticket HS-998273 has intake notes and the original assessor request. If Brightline requires raw SHAs or additional log context we can provide them under a narrow NDA/secure transfer — let us know which PRs and we will coordinate a redaction-approved export.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether the artifacts meet Brightline's intake criteria or if you need additional mapping (e.g., deeper sampling or correlation with deploy tracing). I can set up a short walkthrough call next week to walk through the chronology.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Product Security Manager | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai

[Attachment stubs in Drive: commit-ownership-matrix.csv (text/csv), ci-runbook-snippet.pdf (application/pdf), deploy-change-chronology.log (text/plain), pr-review-sample.patch (text/x-diff)]
